name: Cast
author: Erin Carter
description: One glossy solid caught forever mid-transformation — a sphere swelling into a rounded cube, collapsing to an octahedron, opening into a torus and back. Smooth SDF blends keep it liquid yet geometric, lit like a polished resin maquette.

params.label: Flow
params.effect: How fast it morphs from one primitive to the next; 0 holds a single shape.

params.label: Reach
params.effect: How far each transition overshoots — low is a gentle cross-fade, high lets the form bulge and pinch on the way.

params.label: Polish
params.effect: Surface gloss, from satin matte to a sharp wet highlight.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer parallaxes the camera; 0 ignores the mouse.
